mainEntity.name: Does Evanston regulate condo associations differently than Chicago?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evanston enforces its own property-standards and rental-registration ordinances alongside the Illinois Condominium Property Act, so compliance looks different than it does across the border in Chicago. We manage Evanston associations with those local requirements built into day-to-day operations.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Evanston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Evanston, Illinois (ZIP 60201, 60202), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Evanston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, high-rises, HOAs, townhomes in Evanston. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Evanston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Evanston association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Evanston association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Evanston board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Evanston can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.

blocks.html: Lincolnwood
blocks.cls: font-display text-2xl text-ink mb-4 group-hover:text-gold-600 transition-colors duration-300

blocks.html: Lincolnwood is a compact Cook County village between Chicago's far North Side and Skokie, a short drive from our Lincoln Square office. Its condominium buildings and townhome communities sit close to Touhy Avenue and the Lincolnwood Town Center area, and their boards need the same things city boards do: accurate books, dependable vendors, and a manager who answers. We bring Chicago-office responsiveness to Lincolnwood associations without a downtown-firm overhead.

We help Morton Grove boards plan those projects, keep reserves honest, and keep owners informed.
